title: 1389. Check if Array is Sorted Ascending

Check if Array is Sorted Ascending

Problem Statement:
Given a number N, followed by an array of N elements, print 'yes' if the array is sorted in ascending order only. Otherwise, print 'no'. 
Input Description:
First line: an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 100000) Second line: N space-separated integers 
Output Description:
Print 'yes' if the array is in strictly or non-strictly ascending order Otherwise, print 'no' 
Sample Input:
3
2 3 7 
Sample Output:
yes
